name: Jordan
label: Daily music listener frustrated by clutter
who: I'm a Premium subscriber who uses Spotify every day, mostly for music, and I listen a lot. Podcasts are occasional for me, and I want my music to come first on the home screen with easy navigation.
value_for_money: These users see Premium as worth it, mainly for ad-free music and daily use; one says years of listening make it worth every penny. Others say they are ready to cancel when the app feels unusable, and one already cancelled a family plan over the interface. Price itself is not discussed.
loyalty: They stay for daily music listening, skipping ads during podcasts while driving, and years of listening history. They would leave if the home screen stays crowded with podcasts and navigation stays hard; one already cancelled a family plan over the interface and another was looking at Deezer.
pain_points: Music filter and navigation add extra steps
App laggy and podcast player buggy
likes: Ad skipping in podcasts while driving
Podcasts and music in one app
Years of listening worth every penny
reasons_to_stay: They value Spotify for daily music and for skipping ads during podcasts when driving, and one says years of listening make it worth every penny. Some like having podcasts in the same app, which keeps them there. Their frustration centers on the home screen and navigation, which they say could push them to cancel, but the core service still matters to them.
tone: Exasperated but conversational, with casual slang, sarcasm, and occasional all-caps venting.
